result.rationale: In the zohocrm CalendarService, refreshOAuthTokens returns a fetch Response when CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT is set (the function's sync branch returns the raw fetch response), yet the caller immediately accesses `zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error` and `.data.expiryDate` — a fetch Response has no `.data`, causing a TypeError on the sync-enabled path. Same pattern affects zoho-bigin and lark. Verified from the diff.

judged_text: In sync mode refreshOAuthTokens returns a fetch Response, but the code immediately reads `zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error` and `zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.expiryDate`. Response has no `.data` property, so `zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error` throws TypeError on the very first Zoho CRM token refresh when credential sync is enabled — the feature path never works for Zoho CRM.

record.issue_text: [BUG] In sync mode refreshOAuthTokens returns a fetch Response, but the code immediately reads `zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error` and `zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.expiryDate`. Response has no `.data` property, so `zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error` throws TypeError on the very first Zoho CRM token refresh when credential sync is enabled — the feature path never works for Zoho CRM.

adjudication.rationale: `refreshOAuthTokens` returns a `fetch` `Response` object when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId` (see `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`). In `packages/app-store/zohocrm/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the code wraps an Axios call with `refreshOAuthTokens(...)` and then immediately accesses `zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error` / `zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.expiryDate`. In sync mode, `zohoCrmTokenInfo` would be a `Response` (no `.data`), causing a runtime `TypeError` and breaking Zoho CRM refresh on that path.
